added.title: Director of Engineering
added.description:
Hilton Grand Vacations is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead one of the largest and most sophisticated resort engineering operations in Hawaiʻi.

This role is ideal for a hands-on engineering leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and people leadership. The successful candidate will be a trusted resource to both campus leadership and the engineering team, bringing credibility through practical knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, life safety, and critical building systems while driving operational excellence across HGV-managed towers within the Hilton Hawaiian Village campus.

Leading all engineering and maintenance operations supporting a 24/7 resort environment, the Director is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality physical environments for owners, guests, and team members. This role oversees complex mechanical, electrical, HVAC, structural, and life safety systems; capital improvement projects; asset preservation initiatives; and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate is an engineering expert who has earned the respect of technical teams through strong operational knowledge and sound decision-making, while also demonstrating the leadership capability to develop talent, manage budgets, partner effectively with union and non-union team members, and contribute to the long-term success of the campus.

Here’s why you’ll love it here

We offer an excellent benefits package to our full-time Team Members that include:
Salary Range: $105,000 ~ $125,000 per year
This position is eligible for a corporate bonus. 
Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance from Day One
Financial Wellness – 401k plan with company match, Life insurance, Company stock purchase program
Team Member Travel Program – enjoy discounted rates at incredible properties around the globe
Flexible PTO plan for managers and above that provides employees with ample time off to rest, recharge, and spend quality time with their loved ones.
Team Member Recognition and numerous learning and advancement opportunities to fuel your professional growth…and more!

HGV was awarded four out of five stars for fostering a culture of work-life balance and family-friendly benefits, and is one of Newsweek’s “America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families.” Over the past 30 years, the highest honor we’ve received is the continued loyalty of our Owners, Members and Guests. We’ve also earned accolades for the remarkable work of our dedicated Team Members throughout our resorts, call centers and corporate offices.

Additional Responsibilities Include:

Lead daily engineering operations across resort towers, including inspections, repairs, and preventive maintenance. 
Ensure all building systems (mechanical, electrical, HVAC) operate safely and efficiently. 
Oversee emergency preparedness and safety protocols. 
Manage departmental budgets, purchasing, and inventory control. 
Supervise maintenance projects in guest rooms, public spaces, and back-of-house areas. 
Maintain compliance with QA standards, OSHA regulations, and internal policies. 
Partner with HR on recruitment, performance management, and labor relations. 
Coordinate onboarding and development plans for engineering team members. 
Collaborate with vendors and suppliers to meet operational and financial goals. 
Provide reporting and forecast support to resort leadership.
Embodies the Hilton Grand Vacations Values of Hospitality, Integrity, Leadership, Teamwork, Ownership, Now,
Completes all required Company training/compliance courses as assigned.
Adheres to Company standards and maintains compliance with all policies and procedures.
Performs other related duties as assigned.

What are we looking for?

To fulfill this role efficiently, you must possess the following minimum qualifications and experience:

High School Diploma or equivalent
2+ years as Director of Engineering in a hotel or resort with 200+ rooms
4+ years of management experience, preferably leading engineering or maintenance teams
5+ years of related engineering experience, preferably in hospitality or facilities management
Experience with sophisticated mechanical systems, building equipment commissioning 
Experience working in Hawaii or a comparable resort destination environment preferred.
PM Systems experience (Synergy, HOTSOS as examples) 
Strong understanding of building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and structural maintenance. 
Knowledge of OSHA standards, emergency preparedness, and safety protocols. 
Experience managing preventive maintenance programs and small-scale renovation projects. 
Ability to manage departmental budgets, control costs, and forecast operational needs. 
Effective verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration. 
Experience leading engineering teams in a union environment or partnering effectively with union-represented team members preferred.
Familiarity with maintenance management systems (e.g., CMMS), building automation systems, and energy management tools.

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

Bachelor’s Degree or higher
LEED, PMP, or trade-specific licenses
Experience leading large-scale capital improvement projects. 
Understanding and proven success with labor relations. 
Knowledge of energy conservation strategies and green building practices. 
Ability to analyze financial data and contribute to long-term reserve planning.

When you join Hilton Grand Vacations, you join a group of Team Members dedicated to helping Owners and Guests around the world make every vacation they take a memorable one. Hilton Grand Vacations is a leading vacation ownership company bringing our Guests vacation dreams to life.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

added.title: Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering
added.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to Team

Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

This Senior Software Development Manager role is part of the Distribution and Supply team which sits within our Technology division. Distribution and Supply owns pricing, inventory, content, and marketplace trust, sourcing high-quality inventory and content, determining availability, pricing products, and helping travelers and partners enjoy a safe, profitable marketplace experience. In this role, you will lead teams that build and operate the marketplace infrastructure enabling travelers to discover, compare, and book travel while helping drive technical direction, develop talent, and deliver results across complex systems

In This Role, You Will

Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable, secure, and reliable software services, including system design, API design, and data modeling.
Provide technical direction for high-quality, maintainable, testable, observable, and operationally sound solutions across multiple services and domains.
Partner with product, design, and engineering teams to translate customer and business requirements into reusable technical solutions and effective service integrations.
Guide the end-to-end lifecycle of services and features, including development, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, incident resolution, and continuous improvement.
Use data, metrics, experimentation, and analytics to prioritize work, validate hypotheses, and improve system performance, reliability, and user experience.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent Level; Technical Degree Preferred.
8+ years of relevant professional experience and 3+ years of people management experience.
Demonstrated ownership and technical leadership across services, multi-service architectures, or a product domain, including responsibility for design, implementation, quality, deployment, and operational health.
Strong proficiency in data structures, algorithms, system design, API design, and data modeling, with hands-on experience applying these fundamentals in real systems.
Hands-on experience with modern web technologies, frameworks, service architectures, and AI-driven tools or workflows that enhance developer productivity or product capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading the design and evolution of multi-service or multi-component architectures, including well-structured APIs, data models, and integration patterns across systems.
Demonstrated success driving technical improvements at scale, including performance tuning, resilience hardening, reliability engineering, or optimization of high-traffic services and user interfaces.
Strong operational excellence practices, including instrumentation, observability, alerting, on-call participation, and incident response that improve long-term service health.
Proven ability to use experimentation, feature flags, A/B testing, analytics, and service metrics to guide technical and product decisions and measure delivered impact.
Experience integrating or extending AI/ML-enabled capabilities across services or applications, including responsible adoption of AI-driven components and guiding teams in the effective, safe use of AI tooling for code quality, testing, and operations.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $184,500.00 to $258,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Guide the evolution of experience platform services, web and app infrastructure, CMS technologies, design systems, and configurable platform capabilities.
Partner closely with the Chief Architect and senior technology leaders to influence technical direction and execute enterprise architecture decisions.
Elevate leadership capability, strengthen engineering practices, and introduce innovative approaches to a technically mature organization.
Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Product, Architecture, and other Expedia Group functions.
Challenge existing assumptions constructively and lead meaningful modernization rather than incremental improvement.
Attract, develop, and retain a diverse organization of engineering and program management talent.

Required

Experience and Qualifications

Extensive experience leading large-scale engineering or platform organizations.
Experience operating with a platform mindset, treating internal developers and product teams as customers.
Proven experience with experience platforms, commerce platforms, design systems, CMS technologies, configurable platforms, or developer platforms.
Strong technical credibility, including the ability to engage deeply in platform architecture and enterprise technology decisions.
A record of scaling engineering organizations while combining strategic vision with strong execution.
Proficient communication, collaboration, and cross-functional influence skills.

Preferred

Experience modernizing platforms within a large-scale technology, commerce, marketplace, media, or travel organization.
Experience partnering peer-to-peer with chief architects or equivalent senior technical leaders.
Experience introducing modern engineering practices within established, high-tenure organizations.

added.title: Director, Infrastructure & Maintenance
added.description:
“Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.”

Voyant Beauty believes our people are more than just employees; they’re the driving force behind everything we achieve. Our culture fosters teamwork, respect, and camaraderie, ensuring that every individual’s contribution is valued and celebrated. We invest in their growth, providing opportunities for development and advancement within our dynamic team.

Voyant Beauty is a company that specializes in the development and manufacturing, of beauty, personal and home care products. We work with various brands, retailers, and businesses to create customer formulations and products tailored to their needs. This can include skincare, haircare, bath and body products, fragrances, and more. Essentially, Voyant Beauty serves as a one-stop-shop for companies looking to bring their beauty and personal care product ideas to life.

Safety is a core value at Voyant Beauty. We prioritize the well-being of our team members, ensuring a safe and secure environment where everyone can thrive and excel.

If you’re seeking to be part of a team where your talents are valued, your safety is paramount, and your efforts contribute to meaningful change, then Voyant Beauty is the place for you. Come join us and be a part of our journey.

A Brief Overview

The Director, Infrastructure & Maintenance is responsible for enterprise strategy, governance, and continuous improvement of facility infrastructure, maintenance systems, and asset reliability across Voyant Beauty's manufacturing network. This role establishes standards and long-range plans that improve facility and equipment reliability, strengthen preventive and predictive maintenance practices, optimize utilities and infrastructure, and improve visibility through CMMS, OEE, and performance metrics. The Director partners closely with site Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, EHS, Quality, IT, and Finance to reduce operational risk, improve asset performance, and ensure infrastructure and maintenance priorities support business objectives

What You Will Do

Develop and lead enterprise strategies, standards, and governance for facility infrastructure, maintenance systems, asset management, and reliability. Establish consistent expectations and best practices across manufacturing locations.
Provide enterprise leadership for CMMS, preventive and predictive maintenance, maintenance planning, asset hierarchies, work-order processes, OEE, and equipment reliability. Drive system adoption, data integrity, and consistent maintenance practices across sites.
Oversee facility infrastructure including HVAC, electrical distribution, boilers, steam, compressed air, water/wastewater, fire protection, life-safety systems, roofing, and general building systems. Lead facility assessments and identify reliability, compliance, capacity, and business-continuity risks.
Develop multi-year infrastructure and maintenance capital roadmaps based on asset condition, operational risk, compliance requirements, capacity needs, and return on investment. Support facility modernization, expansion, equipment replacement, and major capital initiatives.
Establish and monitor enterprise KPIs for maintenance effectiveness, equipment uptime, OEE, facility health, utility performance, and reliability. Use data and root-cause analysis to identify improvement opportunities and drive accountability.
Partner with site and functional leaders to align infrastructure and maintenance priorities with operational objectives. Lead change-management, training, best-practice sharing, vendor partnerships, and enterprise initiatives that strengthen maintenance and facility capabilities.
Lead utility optimization, energy reduction, water conservation, and sustainability initiatives.
Support regulatory, insurance, permitting, audit-readiness, and corrective-action activities related to infrastructure and maintenance.
Partner with Engineering and Operations on equipment commissioning and maintenance integration for capital projects.
Manage key contractors, engineering firms, consultants, service providers, and equipment partners.
Support investigations involving infrastructure failures, equipment reliability, maintenance gaps, or utility disruptions.
Provide senior leadership with facility health, reliability, capital, and risk assessments.
Support critical infrastructure or equipment issues outside normal business hours as needed

Education Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Facilities Management, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Technology, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline. (Required)

Experience Qualifications

10+ years Progressive experience in maintenance, reliability, infrastructure/facilities engineering, asset management, manufacturing engineering, or industrial operations. (Required)
4-6 years Experience leading multi-site or enterprise maintenance, reliability, infrastructure, or engineering programs. (Required)
4-6 years Demonstrated experience with CMMS, preventive and predictive maintenance, asset reliability, OEE/KPI reporting, infrastructure assessment, and capital planning. (Required)
4-6 years Experience in regulated manufac turing environments such as personal care, cosmetics, OTC, pharmaceutical, food and beverage, or consumer products. (Preferred)

Skills And Abilities

Facility Infrastructure & Industrial Utilities (High proficiency)
Maintenance & Reliability Strategy (High proficiency)
CMMS Administration & Governance (High proficiency)
Preventive / Predictive Maintenance & Asset Management (High proficiency)
OEE, Maintenance KPIs & Performance Reporting (High proficiency)
Capital Planning & Asset Lifecycle Management (High proficiency)
Facility Risk, Compliance & Audit Readiness (High proficiency)
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement (High proficiency)
Multi-Site Leadership & Change Management (High proficiency)
Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence (High proficiency)
Financial Analysis, Budgeting & ROI (High proficiency)
Contractor & Vendor Management (Medium proficiency)
Energy Management & Sustainability (Medium proficiency)

Licenses and Certifications

Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (Preferred)
Certified Energy Manager (CEM) or Certified Facility Manager (CFM) (Preferred)
Lean Six Sigma Certification (Preferred)
Project Management Professional (PMP) (Preferred)

added.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a Sr
Director, Operations Engineering
located in Guadalajara North, Campus.

Reporting to the Sr Director Operations
the Director, Operations Engineering will be responsible for defining and executing the long‑term roadmap and strategic vision for Advanced Assembly, SMT manufacturing, and next‑generation technologies, ensuring scalable industrialization, successful new product introductions, and sustainable operational excellence.

What a typical day looks like:

Technology process deployment is for all business units and value add services organization.
Serve as a key member of the management team that sets the company’s strategic direction.
Develop strategic planning for the direction and control of manufacturing process development activities.
Formulate long-term objectives and standards of performance for the department.
Assure that the department achieves objectives and project completion within budget and time frame.
Be a student of current industry trends, ensuring that the company maintains and expands its manufacturing technology leadership position.
Motivate staff and provide technical direction and guidance, as well as hands-on project management, recognizing the role as that of both manager and support resource/mentor.
Assure that the manufacturing process is designed for specific needs, but with wider applications/tolerances in mind.
Hire and direct staff of senior group members to acquire necessary resources to meet scheduled commitments.
Ensure implementation and refinement as required of formal process to support the product development process.

The experience we’re looking to add to our team:

BA/BS/MBA or equivalent work experience.
10+ years in manufacturing, including at least 7 years in management roles.
Highly technical background with hands‑on experience leading and operating advanced manufacturing laboratories, including product launches, SMT operations, process characterization, and manufacturing industrialization, in high‑complexity environments.
Proven experience in New Product Introduction (NPI), including product and new technology launches, from concept and validation through production ramp‑up.
Strong expertise with large, high‑density components, including BGA packages up to 100 × 100, ensuring robust process development, assembly reliability, and product quality.
Nice to have following technical skills 1. Related to Data Center/Hyperscale's CEC): Components: ASICs, CPUs, GPUs and complex BGAs, Optical Packages such Co-package optics (CPOs), Pluggable optics etc. PCB: PCB fabrication process and impact of VIPPO, Lamination, etc. PCBA: Deeper experience in SMT to Final assembly including Thermal management (Heatsink, TIM, Liquid & Cryo Cooling, Cold Plate.
Advanced English communication skills (verbal and written).
Familiarity with managing large teams (DL).

Competitive Salary.
Life & Medical insurance.
Christmas Bonus.
Food Coupons.
Saving Fund.

Job Summary

Provides a high level of property maintenance knowledge. Position has overall responsibility for maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection. Accountable for managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintenance and energy conservation. Develops and implements strategies that will deliver products and services, which meet or exceed the needs and expectations of guests and employees while maximizing the financial performance. Responsible for maintaining standards and regulatory requirements. Leads the emergency response team for all facility issues.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the engineering and maintenance or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/Electrical/Plumbing.

OR

2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 4 years experience in the engineering and maintenance or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/Electrical/Plumbing.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Engineering Operations and Budgets

Works with property and regional engineering leadership team to determine how Engineering is performing against budget and highlights areas of concern to leadership.
Manages the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment and electrical systems in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures.
Administers service contracts to support property needs.
Ensures fire crew has complete understanding of all procedures, equipment and alarms.
Coaches and supports engineering leadership team to effectively manage controllable expenses (e.g., wages, heat, light and power, water consumption, tools and equipment, grounds keeping supplies, uniforms, vendors, service agreements, inventory, etc.).
Manages and controls heat, light and power.
Develops an engineering operating strategy that is aligned with the property/brand’s business strategy.
Develops and manages Engineering budget.
Ensures integration of departmental goals in game plans.
Oversees execution of long term preventative maintenance and 10 year asset protection plans.
Reviews financial reports and statements to determine how Engineering is performing against budget.
Addresses potential areas of concern and proposing solutions to owners in a proactive manner.
Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.
Supervises construction to ensure timely completion of projects within budgetary guidelines.

Maintaining Engineering Standards

Ensures compliance with state, local and federal regulations.
Maintains property life safety systems (e.g., fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems, and alarm systems).
Ensures building and equipment licenses, permits and certifications are current.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.

Managing Profitability

Manages areas of operation to budget by reviewing operating statements, budget worksheets and payroll progress reports.
Monitors and manages the payroll function.
Manages department's controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
Participates in the development of department's capital expenditure goals; manages projects as needed.
Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
Prepares weekly and period end P&L critiques.
Understands the impact of department's operation on the overall property financial goals; educates staff on details as appropriate.
Reviews and manages controllable expenses such as, heat, light, power, water consumption, tools and equipment, grounds keeping supplies, uniforms, vendors, service agreements, etc.

Conducting Human Resources Activities

Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Utilizes employee feedback and an “open door” policy to identify and address employee problems or concerns in a timely manner.
Celebrates successes by publicly recognizing the contributions of team members.
Resolves guest problems and complaints.
Brings issues to the attention of Human Resources as necessary.
Ensures that regular on-going communication takes place throughout the engineering operation to communicate daily operations activities, set expectations and create awareness of business objectives.
